_note: Special election formats by state. 'rcv' = ranked-choice general election; 'topTwo' = top-two/top-four primary system so two general candidates can share a party; 'majorityRequired' = a candidate needs 50%+ or the race goes to a runoff. Builder-compiled, unverified; correct in admin. Runoff dates are left null until entered from an official source.

ME.note: Ranked-choice general for federal offices only.

GA.note: General-election runoff if no candidate exceeds 50%.
